name: Shuffling four-floor 707
desc: Four-on-the-floor with a shuffling late-hat feel: 909 kick, tight 707 snare on 2&4, offbeat open hats, and 16th closed hats pushed late for a live-drummer disco strut. Ghost snares breathe in at full, ride joins at peak, crash gates every 8th cycle.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

shuf.doc: hat lateness in cycles - shuffle amount

code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.26).lpf(3500), s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.64).room(.3), s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR707").degradeBy(.75).gain(.18).pan(.42), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(${gain}*.55).lpf(6000).pan(.62), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR707").late("[0 ${shuf} 0 ${shuf}]*4").gain("[.5 .2 .35 .16]*4").lpf(sine.range(4500, ${hcut}).slow(8)).pan(cosine.range(.36,.64).slow(7)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("rd(5,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.24).pan(.66), s("cr ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
